River Settlements

The river gives your people passage and livelihood. You learned to cross its currents and to lend breath to those it almost took.

What do you miss about the sound of the docks?

Rules

Type: Culture. Status: Proposal. Choose one paired option; do not mix the rank from one with the card from another.

- Athletics 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.3f16fc9d850d0e0a.JournalEntryPage.5b778e503e5fd64a]{Expert River Crossing}. - Life 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.85442bfefbe9d679.JournalEntryPage.3a15668fd31a6c80]{Shared Breath}.

Grant at level 0. Duplicate grants provide 1 stage DP each; never promote a rank automatically. No discipline purchases at level 0. Ancestry does not restrict this choice. Follow each card’s explicit equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +7 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
